details.dressNote: Please join us in formal attire in whatever color makes you feel your best, while avoiding white, cream, black or gray dresses. We recommend bringing a shawl or jacket to cover up during the church ceremony, and to keep you warm during our garden reception as it might get chilly at night.
details.giftsText:
Your presence at our celebration is the greatest gift of all. 
 Should you wish to honor us with a gift, a financial contribution toward our future together would be deeply appreciated.
